summary.p: Allows you to send show data from the game out through a serial port
Useful if you for example had an Arduino board and wanted to control a bot in real life

page.title: Data
page.p: Currently, the data is sent as commands. Each command ending with a new line (\n)
For example, "c pause" is a control command sent when the show is unpaused, "c unpause" would be the opposite
The signal command starts with an "s" and contains a list of bits (ex: "s 166,42")
